name: shell_exec
description: Run a shell command synchronously and return its combined output. Use for one-shot commands like reading files or listing directories.

name: process_spawn
description: Start a long-running process. Returns its PID. The process inherits TABULA_URL/TABULA_HOME and receives TABULA_SPAWN_TOKEN so it can connect to the kernel.

name: process_kill
description: Stop a running process by PID.

name: process_list
description: List all spawned processes with PID, command, and alive status.
